//: THIS FILE IS THE FIX FOR A PRODUCTION CRASH. Do not delete it.
Without it, a build rooted at oauth-bootstrap/ walks up and inherits the
repository's tsconfig.json, which targets a bundler: module ES2022,
moduleResolution bundler. That is correct for the repo, where esbuild and
vitest resolve extensionless relative imports. It is wrong here, because
Vercel's Node runtime resolves imports at run time, and Node's ESM resolver
requires an explicit file extension. The emitted code loads fine under a
bundler and dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND under Node, which surfaces as
CommonJS with node resolution makes the extensionless specifiers in this
directory correct by construction. Reproduced and verified both ways; see
test/novra/bootstrap-runtime.test.ts, which compiles these entrypoints the
way the runtime does and invokes them.
